actions.action: Preview the full downstream token impact
actions.mechanism: Resolve reverse dependencies separately for each brand and theme, exposing actual changes rather than every referenced token.
actions.implementation: Build a dependency graph; recompute affected aliases in a draft. Show resolution paths, changed values, unchanged overrides, and cycle errors.
actions.check: Edit a base beneath a three-level alias; verify every changed descendant appears. Introduce a cycle; require a readable path and block publication.
actions.risk: Flattened token exports can hide dependency paths.

actions.action: Preserve and explain intentional brand differences
actions.mechanism: Explicit override provenance distinguishes inherited values from deliberate brand decisions throughout resolution and editing.
actions.implementation: Display each override’s source, alias or literal value, and rationale. Preserve its definition; require an explicit brand-scoped operation to replace it.
actions.check: Change a shared base: a literal override stays unchanged; an alias override retains its reference and exposes any resulting value change.
actions.risk: A preserved override may still create illegible pairs.

actions.action: Evaluate actual rendered text and background pairs
actions.mechanism: Usage-specific checks capture contrasting outcomes when one token serves multiple roles across themes and brands.
actions.implementation: For affected rendered pairs, calculate current and proposed contrast using effective backgrounds and applicable text thresholds. Mark unresolved compositing cases for manual review.
actions.check: Use one token as both text and background. Verify each usage is checked independently, including light and dark themes.
actions.risk: Color checks cannot establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Make proposed and current values explicitly comparable
actions.mechanism: Textual differences and persistent labels communicate changes without requiring designers to distinguish swatch colors.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-accessible current/proposed columns with numeric values, alias paths, brand, theme, contrast ratios, and written status. Include matched component previews.
actions.check: In grayscale, identify which values changed and which pairs need review. Verify screen-reader output distinguishes current from proposed values.
actions.risk: Unfiltered comparisons can overwhelm designers reviewing 180 tokens.

actions.action: Require a revision-bound pair review before publishing
actions.mechanism: A publication gate makes unresolved consequences visible and prevents earlier approvals from covering later edits.
actions.implementation: List newly failing, still failing, and uncheckable affected pairs with usage locations. Require correction or explicit documented disposition; invalidate affected approvals after edits.
actions.check: Attempt publication with an undisposed pair, then modify an approved dependency. Both attempts must require review; cycle errors remain blocking.
actions.risk: Routine exceptions can normalize unresolved legibility problems.

actions.mechanism: Constrained search explores repairs while minimizing collateral changes and respecting protected brand overrides.
actions.implementation: Let designers choose adjustable tokens and protected values. Generate draft candidates; rank by remaining failing pairs and changed usages. Apply only after explicit selection.
actions.check: Protect a brand override and request repairs. Verify it remains untouched, all affected pairs are rechecked, and infeasible constraints produce no claimed solution.
actions.risk: Numerically acceptable repairs may undermine visual identity.

actions.action: Publish palette changes as reversible atomic revisions
actions.mechanism: A consistent snapshot prevents partially updated aliases or themes from escaping the reviewed proposal.
actions.implementation: Bundle token definitions, override provenance, resolved values, and review results into one versioned revision. Reject stale publication attempts and support whole-revision rollback.
actions.check: Simulate a concurrent base edit and an interrupted publish. Neither may expose mixed revisions; rollback must restore previous definitions and values.
actions.risk: Consumers need revision-aware loading to preserve atomicity.
